label: Nested location quotient (canonical)
formula_summary: (local_share / city_share); category/type share against their own domain total (parent-relative)
grounding: Isard (1960); Miller Gibson & Wright (1991); ADR-0017 D1

label: Global (city-relative) location quotient
formula_summary: (local_share / city_share); every level's share against the all-domains grand total (city-relative)
grounding: Isard (1960); OA-D0 geo sign-off C7; #240 issue body

label: Share difference
grounding: OA-D0 geo sign-off C7 (typed columns, incompatible units)

label: Empirical-Bayes shrunk location quotient
formula_summary: shrunk_share = (local + k*city_share) / (local_base + k); shrunk_lq = shrunk_share / city_share; k = oa_min_poi_base_n
grounding: Efron & Morris (1975) JASA; Agresti (2013) Categorical Data Analysis 3rd ed. Sec 3.3; OA-D0 geo sign-off C4

label: Raw within-group share
grounding: OA-D0 geo sign-off C3 (expected to fail the completeness-contamination gate)

label: Binomial-significance z-score (SLQ)
formula_summary: expected = local_base * city_share; variance = local_base * city_share * (1 - city_share); z = (observed - expected) / sqrt(variance)
grounding: Isserman (1977) JAIP; Wilson (1927) normal approximation to the binomial; OA-D0 geo sign-off C4/#280 issue body

label: POI density
formula_summary: local_stock / area_km2 (ST_Area in native metric CRS; PLR grain only)
grounding: Openshaw (1984) MAUP; OA-D0 geo sign-off C5/C8; OA-D0 domain sign-off Condition C; #280 issue body

label: POIs per 1,000 residents
formula_summary: local_stock / residents_total * 1000 (EWR population; exact snapshot_year=reference_year match only)
grounding: OA-D0 geo sign-off C10; OA-D0 domain sign-off Condition C (denominator endogenous to displacement); #280 issue body
